description: Ends a viral alert by alertId (from list_viral_alerts or create_viral_alert). Free. If this alert is what started the profile's tracking and no other active alert of yours needs it, the paid refresh crawls stop as well; tracking you started yourself with track_profile is left untouched. Returns not_found when the alert does not exist or already ended. Cost: free.

alertId.description: Alert id from list_viral_alerts or create_viral_alert

name: delete_viral_alert
title: Delete a Viral Alert
